title: Elucidation of dynamic microRNA regulations in cancer progression using integrative machine learning.
authors: Dogan, Haluk; Hakguder, Zeynep; Madadjim, Roland; Scott, Stephen; Pierobon, Massimiliano; Cui, Juan
one_liner_zh: 该文用集成机器学习推断癌症中microRNA-mRNA动态调控网络，虽涉及转录因子但核心是miRNA调控，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: MOTIVATION: Empowered by advanced genomics discovery tools, recent biomedical research has produced a massive amount of genomic data on (post-)transcriptional regulations related to transcription factors, microRNAs, long non-coding RNAs, epigenetic modifications and genetic variations. Computational modeling, as an essential research method, has generated promising testable quantitative models that represent complex interplay among different gene regulatory mechanisms based on these data in many biological systems. However, given the dynamic changes of interactome in chaotic systems such as cancers, and the dramatic growth of heterogeneous data on this topic, such promise has encountered unprecedented challenges in terms of model complexity and scalability. In this study, we introduce a new integrative machine learning approach that can infer multifaceted gene regulations in cancers with a particular focus on microRNA regulation. In addition to new strategies for data integration and graphical model fusion, a supervised deep learning model was integrated to identify conditional microRNA-mRNA interactions across different cancer stages. RESULTS: In a case study of human breast cancer, we have identified distinct gene regulatory networks associated with four progressive stages. The subsequent functional analysis focusing on microRNA-mediated dysregulation across stages has revealed significant changes in major cancer hallmarks, as well as novel pathological signaling and metabolic processes, which shed light on microRNAs' regulatory roles in breast cancer progression. We believe this integrative model can be a robust and effective discovery tool to understand key regulatory characteristics in complex biological systems. AVAILABILITY: http://sbbi-panda.unl.edu/pin/.
abstract_zh: 动机：借助先进的基因组学发现工具，近期生物医学研究已产生了大量关于转录因子、microRNA、长链非编码RNA、表观遗传修饰及遗传变异相关的（后）转录调控基因组数据。计算建模作为一种基本研究方法，已基于这些数据在许多生物系统中生成了有前景的可测试定量模型，这些模型代表了不同基因调控机制间的复杂相互作用。然而，鉴于癌症等混沌系统中相互作用组的动态变化，以及该主题下异质性数据的急剧增长，这种前景在模型复杂性和可扩展性方面遇到了前所未有的挑战。在本研究中，我们引入了一种新的集成机器学习方法，能够推断癌症中的多方面基因调控，特别关注microRNA调控。除了数据整合和图模型融合的新策略外，还集成了一种监督深度学习模型，以识别不同癌症阶段的条件性microRNA-mRNA相互作用。结果：在人类乳腺癌的案例研究中，我们识别了与四个进展阶段相关的不同基因调控网络。随后的功能分析聚焦于跨阶段的microRNA介导失调，揭示了主要癌症标志物的显著变化，以及新的病理信号和代谢过程，这为microRNA在乳腺癌进展中的调控作用提供了见解。我们相信，这种集成模型可以成为理解复杂生物系统中关键调控特征的稳健且有效的发现工具。可用性：http://sbbi-panda.unl.edu/pin/。
